issues.title: Coupon not applying at checkout
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon code was not applying at checkout for the Advanced Course and showed an "Invalid coupon" message.

issues.title: Wrong company name on invoice (GST part)
issues.problem_statement: The company name shown in the GST part of the customer's invoice is wrong.

issues.title: Extending coupon expiry date
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants to extend the expiry date of their coupon.

items.description: Customer edited the coupon, selected the Advanced Course in its Products section and saved it, following support's guidance (the coupon had been assigned only to the Starter Course), and confirmed that the discount now shows at checkout.
evidence: Ho gaya. Ab test karta hoon... haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.
Coupon ko edit karo, Products section mein Advanced Course select karo aur save kar do.

items.description: Support will check about the wrong company name in the GST part of the customer's invoice and let the customer know.
evidence: main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.

items.description: Support explained that the customer can extend the coupon's expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is available.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
